sharedGeofenceHint: Choose a shape to start drawing a geofence.
userTermsPrompt: By clicking Accept, you agree to our Terms of Service and confirm that you have read our Privacy Policy.
deviceIdentifierHelp: IMEI, serial number, or other ID. It must match the identifier the device reports to the server.
notificationGeofenceLabel: Link geofences to devices or groups to receive these events.
settingsHubDescription: Manage your account, fleet and system settings
settingsPreferencesDescription: Map, device list, sounds and access token
settingsNotificationsDescription: Alerts by event type and channel
settingsGeofencesDescription: Draw and manage areas on the map
tableEmptyDescription: Create the first item to get started
loginTagline: Live location, trip history, reports and alerts – in one picture.
loginSubtitle: Enter your credentials to sign in
notFoundDescription: The link may be broken or the page may have moved.
telemetryNoData: No data has been received from this device yet.
telemetryFuelHint: Set the tank capacity on the device to show liters
vehicleFuelCapacityHelp: How many liters a full tank holds. Used to turn liters into a percentage and back.
vehicleFuelExplain: If the fuel gauge shows the wrong percentage, the device usually reports liters: set the tank capacity and pick "Liters". For further calibration, set a factor on the fuel parameter in the "Parameters" tab.
vehicleFuelNoReading: No fuel reading with these settings
vehicleTiresMapping: Which parameter belongs to each tire
vehicleTiresExplain: A tire below the minimum is marked red, and one off the recommended pressure is marked orange. Pressures are entered in the display unit.
vehicleParamsExplain: Hide parameters, rename them, scale them by a factor and add a unit. You can also tap any tile on the dashboard.
parameterFactorHelp: Shown value = device value × factor + offset
fleetDocumentsDescription: Licenses, insurance, inspections and other files with expiry dates
fleetDocumentsPageDescription: All vehicle and driver documents by expiry date
fleetRoleDescription: Permissions in the fleet database: documents, drivers, vehicles
fleetNoProfile: This user gets a fleet profile on their first login
adminOverviewDescription: Every customer, device, user and bill in the system
adminCustomersDescription: Customers of the service with their devices and users
adminCustomerDevicesHelp: The customer's devices. All of the customer's users see them.
adminNoDevicesForCustomer: This customer has no devices yet
adminCustomerUsersHelp: The customer's Traccar users. They get access to every device of the customer.
adminNoUsersForCustomer: This customer has no users yet
adminLinkUserHelp: The user gets access to all of the customer's devices. A user moved from another customer loses that customer's devices.
adminCreateUserHelp: Creates a new login and links it to this customer. Password of at least 6 characters.
adminDevicesDescription: Every device in the system, its customer and its setup
adminDeviceSetupDescription: Five short steps: device, SIM, customer, vehicle and sensors
adminAssignDevicesHelp: The customer's users get access to the devices. A device that belonged to another customer is removed from that customer.
adminUsersDescription: Every user in the system and the customer they belong to
adminStepDeviceHelp: A clear name (for example the license plate) and the IMEI printed on the device
adminImeiHelp: 15 digits, printed on the device label
adminServerHint: Set the device to report to:
adminStepCustomerHelp: The device appears for every user of the chosen customer
adminSpeedLimitHelp: Above this speed an overspeed event is raised
adminOdometerCurrent: Now in the system: {0} km. Leave empty to keep it
adminStepSensorsHelp: Pick what is wired to the device and to which wire. Each sensor shows the value the device sends right now, so you can check the wiring immediately.
adminSensorNoPosition: The device has not reported yet, so there are no live values to check. You can still set up the sensors now.
adminSensorIgnitionHelp: When the engine runs. Drives trips, stops and engine hours
adminSensorFuelHelp: Fuel level in the tank, in percent or liters
adminSensorTemperatureHelp: Fridge, cargo hold or any other probe
adminSensorDoorHelp: Door or cargo hold open / closed
adminSensorPanicHelp: A press raises an SOS alarm
adminSensorVoltageHelp: Vehicle battery or power supply voltage
adminSensorTiresHelp: TPMS. Shown on the vehicle dashboard
adminSensorCustomHelp: Any other value the device sends, with a name, factor and unit
adminSensorCalibrationHelp: Enter what the sensor shows with an empty tank and with a full tank. If the vehicle is in that state now, press "Now" to copy the live reading.
adminSensorNeedSource: Choose which value the device sends for this sensor
adminSensorNeedInput: Choose the input the sensor is wired to
adminSensorNeedCalibration: Calibration needs an empty reading, a full reading and the tank capacity
adminAdvancedHelp: All Traccar fields: calendar, image, documents and free attributes
adminFleetDisabled: The fleet database is not configured, so customers and billing are off. Device and user management still works.
adminNoCustomerPermission: You do not have the customer permission (customers.manage). If it was just granted, reconnect.
adminNoBillingPermission: You do not have the billing permission (billing.manage). If it was just granted, reconnect.
adminBillingDescription: Payment requests to customers, payments and open balances
adminInvoiceDisclaimer: This is a payment request for internal tracking. Tax invoices are issued by the accounting system.
adminGenerateBillsHelp: One bill per customer with an active subscription, by their billable devices. Customers already billed for the period are skipped.
adminNoActiveSubscriptions: No active subscriptions. Set one up in the customer's Billing tab.
adminSubscriptionHelp: The customer's plan and prices. An empty price takes the plan price.
adminBasePriceHelp: A fixed amount per customer, on top of the device price
fleetHubDescription: Vehicles, drivers, maintenance and validity in one place
fleetExpiryHint: Validity dates appear on the validity screen and are flagged 30 days before they expire
fleetExpiriesPageDescription: Annual test, insurance, lease and driving licenses by expiry date
fleetExpiriesAllClearDescription: Nothing has expired and nothing expires in the next 30 days
fleetExpiriesEmptyDescription: Enter test and insurance dates on the vehicle page and license dates on the driver page
fleetMaintenanceStatusDescription: How much is left until each vehicle's next service, by distance, engine hours or date
fleetMaintenanceSectionDescription: Computed from the vehicle's latest position
fleetMaintenanceNoneDescription: Create a maintenance item and link it to a vehicle from the vehicle's connections
fleetMaintenanceMarkDoneConfirm: Mark "{0}" as done now? The next service will be due in {1}.
fleetMaintenanceShared: This maintenance is shared by {0} vehicles and the reset applies to all of them. To track them separately, create one per vehicle.
